_meta.method: field-for-field read of real source, no invented fields

PendingWrite_vs_PendingActuation.ggen_igniter_struct: GgenIgniter.PendingActuation (pending_actuation.ex) -- explicitly documents itself as mirroring this ggen IR

fields.note: igniter's is nilable for :eval; ggen's PendingWrite has no eval-mode concept at this layer

fields.ggen_field: frontmatter: Frontmatter (mode/injection directives, match specs, etc.)
fields.recommendation: igniter's semantic_source is a plain untyped map carrying provenance identity; ggen's Frontmatter also carries write-mode directives (inject/match specs) that PendingActuation only expresses indirectly via the operation atom. Low-risk: no action needed unless inject-mode support is added (already disclosed as future work in the moduledoc).

fields.ggen_field: (none -- PendingWrite has no identity/hash/ownership fields; those live in SyncReport/write.rs's plan_write, not on the struct itself)
fields.igniter_equivalent: logical_id, previous_hash, desired_hash, operation, ownership, compensation_data
fields.note: igniter's PendingActuation is intentionally RICHER than ggen's PendingWrite -- it fuses PendingWrite + ggen's write.rs plan_write decision logic + ggen_igniter's own compensation/undo need into one struct. This is a genuine, deliberate divergence, not a gap.

SyncReport_vs_igniter_aggregate.igniter_equivalent: No single named struct -- aggregated ad hoc inside ReconcileReactor.finalize_evidence/1 (results/tracked/outputs local vars) and returned via Reactor.run's generic result map

fields.igniter_equivalent: outputs map keys (results filtered to outcome in [:written, :unchanged])
fields.note: igniter conflates :written and :unchanged into one 'outputs' set at line 1433-1437; ggen's `written` is real writes-or-injects only, tracked separately from `skipped`.

fields.igniter_equivalent: no equivalent persisted collection -- individual outcome atoms (:skipped_exists/:skipped_match) exist per-result but are never aggregated into a named 'skipped' list on the final receipt/report
fields.recommendation: add a 'skipped' list (path + reason) to the receipt metadata in finalize_evidence/1, mirroring ggen's SyncReport.skipped -- cheap, and closes an observability gap (why N targets were skipped is currently only inferable by re-reading the events list).

fields.ggen_field: graph_hash_hex: BLAKE3 of the post-Enrich canonical GRAPH STATE (after ontology parse + construct queries run)
fields.igniter_equivalent: graph_hash: sha256 of the raw ontology FILE BYTES only (line 1439-1440)
fields.recommendation: REAL DIVERGENCE, not cosmetic: ggen's graph_hash reflects the graph after construct-query enrichment, so two ontologies producing the same enriched facts via different surface syntax can still differ, and a construct-query change alone changes the receipt even if ontology bytes don't. igniter's graph_hash is purely a file-content hash and cannot detect a change in derived facts (there is no construct/enrich stage in igniter today to hash the output of). Recommendation: rename igniter's field to something honest like 'ontology_file_hash' rather than 'graph_hash' until/unless an enrichment stage exists -- low-risk, one-line rename + doc note, avoids a misleading parity claim.

fields.igniter_equivalent: no equivalent map -- individual `outcome` atoms exist per-result but are not persisted as a path->decision map anywhere durable
fields.recommendation: fold this into the same fix as `skipped` above: a decisions map keyed by path is cheap to build from the existing `results` list already in scope in finalize_evidence/1.

fields.ggen_field: packs: BTreeMap<String,String> (pack name -> BLAKE3 of pack content hash)
fields.igniter_equivalent: pack_dir is recorded per-manifest-entry as informational metadata only (Manifest moduledoc); no content-hash-per-pack tracking anywhere
fields.recommendation: not a one-line fix -- would require a real pack content-hashing pass. Record as a recommendation only, not implemented here (out of the low-risk bar for this task).

fields.ggen_field: closure: BTreeMap<String,String> (every governing input -- manifest/ontology/templates/rule files/gate files/from:-bodies -- hashed, MISSING if unreadable)
fields.igniter_equivalent: no equivalent input-closure map exists anywhere in igniter
fields.recommendation: REAL, VALUABLE GAP: igniter's receipt currently cannot prove which template/ontology/config files actually governed a given run -- only the ontology's own hash is captured (as graph_hash, itself only a file hash, see above). A future receipt hardening pass should add a closure-style map (template path, ontology path, manifest/config path -> hash-or-MISSING) to `Receipt.metadata`. Not implemented here -- this is a structural addition beyond a low-risk one-liner.

SyncReceipt_ReceiptPayload_vs_igniter_Re.igniter_struct: GgenIgniter.Receipt (single flat struct, no separate chain-record/payload split)

payload_fields.note: same divergence as above -- file hash, not enriched-graph hash; also igniter's version is untyped free-form metadata, not a first-class struct field

payload_fields.igniter_equivalent: files: [String.t()] (paths only, NO per-file content hash retained on the receipt)
payload_fields.recommendation: igniter's `files` list drops the per-file hash ggen keeps in `outputs`; the per-file hash is recoverable indirectly only via pre_run_hash/post_run_hash's combined digest, not per-file. Cheap, valuable, low-risk fix: change `files` to a path->hash map (or add a sibling `file_hashes` map) in Receipt.new/append! -- the hashes are already computed in `outputs` locally in finalize_evidence/1 and simply not threaded into the receipt struct.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.recommendation: trivial one-line add: a `schema_version` field defaulting to 1, guards future format changes the same way ggen's does.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.igniter_equivalent: none -- igniter has no notion of an instruction/activity index within a run
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: not clearly applicable -- ggen's is for a multi-instruction law-engine trace; igniter's reconciliation is single-recipe-per-receipt today. Low relevance, not recommended to port.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.ggen_field: ts_ns (fixed 0 by design, see sync.rs module doc)
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: genuinely different design choice: ggen deliberately avoids wall-clock in the chain hash (determinism); igniter's receipt is explicitly a wall-clock HISTORY log, not a hash-chained deterministic record. Not a gap -- different, intentional designs for different purposes.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.igniter_equivalent: derivable from finished_at - started_at but NOT stored as a field
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.recommendation: cheap one-line add: store `finished_at - started_at` (ms) directly on the receipt at append time rather than requiring every reader to re-parse both timestamps and subtract.
if/when igniter grows an unattended-dispatch caller (mirroring ggen-mcp's), add an `origin` field to Receipt the same way -- not needed today, no current caller to tag.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.ggen_field: payload_hash_hex / prev_chain_hash_hex / chain_hash_hex (real cryptographic hash chain over the payload)
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.igniter_equivalent: NONE as a chain hash -- reconstruct_standing/2 instead re-derives continuity by checking receipt[N].pre_run_hash == receipt[N-1].post_run_hash, a weaker, content-hash-based continuity check, not a hash-chain over the receipt record itself
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.recommendation: REAL, notable divergence: ggen's chain_hash_hex covers (payload_hash, prev_chain_hash) so tampering with an OLD receipt line is detectable even if pre/post file hashes still happen to line up; igniter's continuity check only verifies FILE STATE continuity, not RECEIPT-RECORD integrity -- a hand-edited receipt line with correct pre/post hashes but altered `standing`/`reason`/`metadata` would pass reconstruct_standing/2 undetected. Recommend (not implemented here, more than one line): add a chain_hash field to Receipt = sha256(receipt_fields_except_chain_hash <> prev_chain_hash), verified alongside the existing pre/post hash check.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: different vocabulary, same role (a closed-set outcome classification gating what happened). igniter's is arguably MORE specific for its domain (distinguishes compensation_failed as an operator-facing incident) -- a real strength, not a gap.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.igniter_equivalent: none (no obligation/law-engine concept in igniter's receipt)
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: not applicable -- igniter has no law/obligation engine equivalent to praxis-core's; not recommended to port without that subsystem existing first.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.igniter_equivalent: files: [String.t()] (closest analog -- the paths this attempt touched) PLUS events (OCEL events which do carry object references, see OcelEmitter.file_object/1)
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: OCEL event objects (via OcelEmitter, see reconcile_reactor.ex lines 1410-1411) already carry a richer object-reference model than a flat object_ids list -- igniter's design routes this through OCEL instead of a flat receipt field. Reasonable parity via a different mechanism, not a gap.

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.ggen_field: signature_hex: Option<String> (cryptographic signature over the record)
chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: no signing capability anywhere in igniter's receipt chain. Real gap if receipts are ever meant to be non-repudiable across trust boundaries; not recommended as a one-liner (needs key management).

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.igniter_equivalent: none (implicit via to_json_map/1's fixed key set)

chain_record_fields (ReceiptRecord, prax.note: not applicable without a corresponding admission-ledger concept in igniter

highest_value_low_risk_recommendations: Rename igniter's metadata["graph_hash"] to metadata["ontology_file_hash"] (or equivalent) -- it is a raw ontology-file hash, not an enriched-graph hash, and the current name overclaims parity with ggen's graph_hash_hex.

Add a `skipped` list and a `decisions` path->outcome map to Receipt.metadata in ReconcileReactor.finalize_evidence/1 -- the underlying `results` data already exists in scope, this is aggregation only, no new computation.
Thread the already-computed per-file hashes (local `outputs` map, reconcile_reactor.ex line 1433-1437) into the receipt as a path->hash map instead of dropping them down to a bare `files` path list.
Add a `duration_ms` field to Receipt, computed once at append! time from started_at/finished_at, instead of leaving every reader to re-derive it.
not_recommended_to_implement_now: A full cryptographic chain_hash_hex + payload_hash_hex chain (real design work, not a one-liner, though it is the most consequential integrity gap found: today a hand-edited receipt line can pass reconstruct_standing/2 undetected as long as pre/post file hashes still line up).
Per-pack content hashing (packs map) and a full input-closure map -- both require new tracking passes, not available as low-risk edits.
Signature_hex-equivalent signing -- needs key management infrastructure not present in igniter.
